text:
maria_pm: Quick heads up — SecureVault is green to go for a joint launch of their KMS + SCIM connector. They want a coordinated marketplace listing + press mention next Wed. Need a launch orchestration checklist. :calendar:
raj_partnerships: Awesome. Do we have alignment on embargo window and technical signoff owners?
sam_infra: I can own technical signoff for our side. Need to confirm SAML metadata exchange and KMS key wrap compatibility.
alan_vendor_pm: From SecureVault: embargo until 2026-04-15 09:00 PDT. We'll provide SCIM test tenant, demo keys, and a short integration guide by EOD Friday.
olivia_marketing: Put me down for launch copy + one-pager. Also need logos and approved customer quotes (if any) for the marketplace tile.
beth_legal: Quick note — vendor logos require our standard trademark clause. Also need to check the partner's data processing addendum (DPA) is in place before public co-marketing.
maria_pm: Noted. High-level checklist I propose: 1) legal signoff, 2) marketplace tile assets + metadata, 3) integration doc + sample configs, 4) staging smoke tests, 5) joint press embargo, 6) canary routing for first 48h. Thoughts?
raj_partnerships: Add: 7) support routing & SLA matrix, 8) joint SLAs for KMS operations, 9) demo recording for sales.
sam_infra: For smoke tests we need: SAML SP metadata (we host), vendor IdP metadata, SCIM create/update/delete flows, KMS wrap/unwrap test vectors. I'll add a small script. Sample SAML snippet:```xml
<EntityDescriptor entityID="https://redwood.ai/saml">...</EntityDescriptor>
```
alan_vendor_pm: We'll run through SCIM user lifecycle and provide logs. Also can confirm HSM-backed keys are available in their pilot.
olivia_marketing: Who will own the marketplace listing form? We need tags (security, secrets, enterprise), short/long descriptions, pricing model blurb (if any).
maria_pm: I can fill the form but need final copy from marketing + approved logo from legal. Target to have listing submitted 48 hours before embargo.
beth_legal: I'll review the assets by Friday if you send them by Thursday EOD. Also will attach approved DPA id.
ops-bot: Reminder: create a staging workspace and grant SecureVault test account access. Command: `/workspace create securevault-integration-staging`
sam_infra: Done — I created `securevault-integration-staging`. Shared creds in lastpass. Running initial SCIM smoke now.
raj_partnerships: Vendor success wants to do a dry-run webinar on Tue (internal). Can we set 30m for product + sales?
olivia_marketing: Tue works. I'll prep a short slide deck and the demo script.
maria_pm: Action items: sam (tech signoff + smoke tests), olivia (marketing assets + deck), beth (legal signoff), alan (vendor deliverables + dry-run), raj (sales outreach). I'll own kickoff coordination and the marketplace submission. Let's reconvene Mon EOD for status. :thumbsup:
alan_vendor_pm: Sounds good — I'll send the SCIM test tenant and demo keys by Friday.
sam_infra: Smoke tests passed basic SCIM create/delete and KMS wrap test vectors; filing a short runbook in the staging channel. Will escalate any failures.
olivia_marketing: Draft copy ready, shared in Google Drive: https://drive.google.com/securevault-rls-draft — awaiting legal logo cert.
beth_legal: Uploaded approved logo assets and DPA id to the shared drive. Please reference `DPA-2026-SV` in comms.
maria_pm: Great progress. If everything stays green I'll file the marketplace listing Tue morning and send embargo PR to comms. Last call for anything missing? :eyes:
